dialogue.speaker: guard
dialogue.text: Regent Aldric. We were beginning to watch for you.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: Have we kept you long?

dialogue.speaker: guard
dialogue.text: Only since the last wagon came in. You came by the ridge road, my lord?

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: We did. Your warning reached us before the turning.

dialogue.speaker: guard
dialogue.text: A longer journey, then.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: *with a tired smile* A better one than finding the crossing ourselves.

dialogue.speaker: guard
dialogue.text: The approach is clear. Mother Serene is expecting you.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: Thank you. And keep someone at the barrier. We can find our way from here.

dialogue.speaker: local
dialogue.text: My lord? A moment, if you can spare it.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: Of course.

dialogue.speaker: local
dialogue.text: They said you were coming to look at the road. Are they saying when we'll have our bridge back?

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: Not yet. I need to see what the crews are working with before I give you a date.

dialogue.speaker: local
dialogue.text: *lets out a frustrated breath* We've had enough dates already.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: Then I won't give you another one today.

dialogue.speaker: local
dialogue.text: It's the hauling. Every load takes longer, and there are fewer carts to share.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: What has been getting through?

dialogue.speaker: local
dialogue.text: Some supplies. Enough lamp oil for the festival, at least. It's the next few loads I'm worried about.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: Were you here when it happened?

dialogue.speaker: local
dialogue.text: *quietly* I saw the flash from the fields. By the time I reached the bank, the middle of the bridge was gone.

dialogue.speaker: local
dialogue.text: It had split the road on both sides. Stone all over the water.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: We've seen damage like this elsewhere. I wish I could tell you why.

dialogue.speaker: local
dialogue.text: Elsewhere? I thought we had been unlucky.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: So did the people I visited before coming here. There have been a few such incidents.

dialogue.speaker: local
dialogue.text: And every place needs the same stone and carts.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: *nods* Yes. That's part of what I've come to discuss.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: Tell my clerk which deliveries are waiting. The crew needs to know what people are still trying to get through.

dialogue.speaker: clerk
dialogue.text: I can take that down now.

dialogue.speaker: local
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know ours isn't the only road.

dialogue.speaker: aldric
dialogue.text: It's still the one you need. Thank you for stopping me.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: He's had little rest between these visits.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: I wish I had a simpler answer for him.

dialogue.speaker: tomas
dialogue.text: Mother? Are these enough cups?

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: *turns back to him* Bring two more, love.

dialogue.speaker: tomas
dialogue.text: Two more. Right.
